chinese_meaning: （體力或智力方面的）能力;才能，才智
example_en: There's no doubting her ability.
example_zh: 她的能力毋庸置疑。

example_en: We always go abroad in the summer.
example_zh: 我們夏天總是到國外去。

chinese_meaning: （尤指上課或工作）缺勤的；缺席的；不在場的
example_en: John has been absent from school/work for three days now.
example_zh: 約翰到現在已經曠課／曠工三天了。

example_en: He's got a strong southern/Boston accent.
example_zh: 他說話帶有很重的南方／波士頓口音。

example_en: Do you accept credit cards?
example_zh: 你們接受信用卡付帳嗎？

chinese_meaning: 令人滿意的；可以接受的；可容許的；贊同的
example_en: Clearly we need to come to an arrangement that is acceptable to both parties.
example_zh: 顯然我們需要作出一個雙方都能接受的安排。

chinese_meaning: 通道;途徑;（接近某地或某人的）機會（或方法）;（使用某物的）權利
example_en: The only access to the village is by boat.
example_zh: 到那個村子去的唯一方法是乘船。

example_en: They paid for his flights and hotel accommodation.
example_zh: 他們支付了他的機票和酒店住宿。

chinese_meaning: 陪同，陪伴;伴隨，和…一起發生（或存在）
example_en: The course books are accompanied by four CDs.
example_zh: 這些課本配有四張光碟。

example_en: a firm of accountants
example_zh: 會計師事務所

example_en: an accurate machine
example_zh: 精密的機器

example_en: As you get older, you have all sorts of aches and pains.
example_zh: 人老了，就會有各種各樣的病痛。

chinese_meaning: （尤指經過努力）完成；達到；實現
example_en: The government's training policy, he claimed, was achieving its objectives.
example_zh: 他稱政府制定的培訓方針即將達到預期目標。

example_en: It gives you a sense of achievement if you actually make it to the end of a very long book.
example_zh: 如果你能真正讀完一本厚書，就會有一種成就感。

example_en: We stood for a few moments, admiring the view.
example_zh: 我們駐足了一會兒，欣賞美麗的景色。

chinese_meaning: （尤指不情願地）承認;供認;招認
example_en: He admitted his guilt/mistake.
example_zh: 他承認有罪／犯了錯誤。

example_en: This is the most advanced type of engine available.
example_zh: 這是現有的最先進的引擎。

chinese_meaning: 有利條件，有利因素；優勢；好處
example_en: The advantage of booking tickets in advance is that you get better seats.
example_zh: 提前訂票的好處就是可以得到比較好的座位。

example_en: an advert for the local radio station
example_zh: 當地廣播電臺推廣節目的廣告

chinese_meaning: （尤指為了推銷某物）登廣告，做廣告，宣傳;公佈;徵聘
example_en: We advertised our car in the local newspaper.
example_zh: 我們在當地報紙上登了廣告出售我們的轎車。

chinese_meaning: 勸告;忠告;向…提供意見，給…出主意
example_en: I think I'd advise him to leave the company.
example_zh: 我想，我會建議他離開這家公司。

chinese_meaning: 我不知道他靠薪水怎麼能買得起新車。
example_en: I don't know how he can afford a new car on his salary.
example_zh: 我不知道他靠薪水怎麼能買得起新車。

example_en: an advertising/employment/estate/travel agency
example_zh: 廣告（代理）公司／職業介紹所／房地產仲介公司／旅行社

example_en: The road ahead is very busy.
example_zh: 前面路上很擁擠。

example_en: My main aim in life is to be a good husband and father.
example_zh: 我人生的主要目標是做一個好丈夫和好爸爸。

example_en: What airline did you fly with?
example_zh: 你乘坐的是哪家航空公司的飛機？

example_en: alcoholic drinks
example_zh: 含酒精的飲料

example_en: The children all look very alike.
example_zh: 孩子長得都很像。

example_en: She's alive and well and living in New Zealand.
example_zh: 她生活得很好，目前住在紐西蘭。

chinese_meaning: 使有可能;允許，准許;容許
example_en: Do you think Dad will allow you to go to Jamie's party?
example_zh: 你認為爸爸會允許你去參加傑米的聚會嗎？

example_en: He read her letter aloud to the rest of the family.
example_zh: 他把她的信大聲讀給家人聽。

example_en: the Roman/Cyrillic alphabet
example_zh: 羅馬/西瑞爾字母表

example_en: She walked home by herself, although she knew that it was dangerous.
example_zh: 她一個人步行回家，儘管她知道那樣做很危險。

example_en: That'll be $52.50 altogether, please.
example_zh: 一共是52.5英鎊。

example_en: His ambition is ultimately to run his own business.
example_zh: 他的抱負是最終能夠經營自己的公司。

example_en: I saw a few familiar faces among the crowd.
example_zh: 我在人群中看見了幾張熟悉的面孔。

chinese_meaning: （尤指不可數事物的）數量；數額；量；總數
example_en: They didn't deliver the right amount of sand.
example_zh: 他們運來的沙子數量不對。

chinese_meaning: 古代的；古老的；年代久遠的
example_en: ancient civilizations/rights/laws
example_zh: 古代文明／自古有之的權利／古代法律

example_en: According to the Bible, an angel told Mary that she would have God's son, Jesus.
example_zh: 據《聖經》所述，一位天使告知瑪利亞她將生下上帝之子耶穌。

example_en: We always celebrate our wedding anniversary with dinner in an expensive restaurant.
example_zh: 我們總是去豪華飯店就餐來慶祝我們的結婚紀念日。

example_en: They announced the death of their mother in the local paper.
example_zh: 他們在一家當地報紙上刊登了母親去世的訃告。

example_en: The president made an unexpected announcement this morning.
example_zh: 今天上午總統發表了一項出人意表的聲明。

example_en: Tina really annoyed me in the meeting this morning.
example_zh: 在今天上午的會上，蒂娜真是把我氣壞了。

example_en: an annual event/visit/holiday
example_zh: 年度大事／每年一次的訪問／每年的假期

example_en: You can't give away Granny's old bookcase - it's a valuable antique.
example_zh: 你不能把奶奶的舊書櫃送人，那可是件值錢的古董啊。

example_en: My mother always gets a bit anxious if we don't arrive when we say we will.
example_zh: 如果我們沒有在說好的時間到達，我母親總會有些擔心。

example_en: Stand with your feet wide apart.
example_zh: 兩腿叉開站立，雙腳間距要大。

example_en: I must apologize to Isobel for my lateness.
example_zh: 我遲到了，必須向伊莎貝爾道個歉。

example_en: I have an apology to make to you - I'm afraid I opened your letter by mistake.
example_zh: 我必須向你道歉，我誤拆了你的信。

example_en: He suddenly appeared in the doorway.
example_zh: 他突然出現在門口。

example_en: a letter of application
example_zh: 求職信

example_en: We could just see the train approaching in the distance.
example_zh: 我們剛好能看到火車從遠處駛來。

example_en: to study architecture
example_zh: 學習建築學

example_en: All areas of the country will have some rain tonight.
example_zh: 今晚全國所有地區都將有降雨。

example_en: They were arguing over which film to go and see.
example_zh: 他們正在爭論去看哪部電影。

example_en: The children had an argument about/over what game to play.
example_zh: 那群孩子為了玩哪個遊戲吵了起來。

example_en: When did you join the army?
example_zh: 你甚麼時候從軍的？

example_en: I'm trying to arrange my work so that I can have a couple of days off next week.
example_zh: 我正設法把工作安排好，以便下週能夠休息兩天。

example_en: They'd made all the arrangements for the party.
example_zh: 他們為聚會作好了一切準備。

example_en: He was arrested when customs officers found drugs in his bag.
example_zh: 海關人員在他的手提包裡發現了毒品，把他拘捕了。

example_en: Hundreds gathered to await the boxer's arrival at the airport.
example_zh: 數百人聚集在機場等候拳擊手的到來。

chinese_meaning: （報紙或雜誌上的）文章，報導;論文
example_en: There was an interesting article on vegetarianism in the paper yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天報紙上登了一篇關於素食主義的有趣文章。

chinese_meaning: 羞恥的，羞愧的;不好意思的，難為情的
example_en: You've got nothing to be ashamed of.
example_zh: 你沒有什麼可感到內疚的。

example_en: She asked me a question.
example_zh: 她向我問一個問題。

example_en: I'm surprised to see you awake - ten minutes ago you were fast/sound (= completely) asleep.
example_zh: 真奇怪，你怎麼醒了——十分鐘前你還睡得很甜呢。

chinese_meaning: 阿司匹靈（尤用於治療頭痛、發燒和腫脹）
example_en: I always take a couple of aspirins when I feel a cold starting.
example_zh: 我覺得開始有感冒症狀時，總會服用幾片阿司匹靈。

chinese_meaning: （尤指學業或工作方面的）任務，功課
example_en: a freelance/photo assignment
example_zh: 自由職業／攝影任務

example_en: an administrative/office assistant
example_zh: 行政／辦公室助理

chinese_meaning: （尤指參加有組織的賽事的）運動員;健兒，擅長運動的人
example_en: He became a professional athlete at the age of 16.
example_zh: 16歲時他成了一名職業運動員。

example_en: an athletics team/club/meeting
example_zh: 田徑隊／俱樂部／運動會

chinese_meaning: 繫，綁；連接；使附著；附上；固定
example_en: I attached a photo to my application form.
example_zh: 我在我的申請表上貼了一張相片。

example_en: He was attacked and seriously injured by a gang of youths.
example_zh: 他被一幫年輕人打成重傷。

chinese_meaning: （尤指為完成難事而進行）努力，嘗試
example_en: He attempted to escape through a window.
example_zh: 他企圖跳窗逃跑。

example_en: Over two hundred people attended the funeral.
example_zh: 二百多人參加了葬禮。

example_en: Ladies and gentlemen, could I have your attention, please?
example_zh: 女士們、先生們，請大家注意一下好嗎？

example_en: It's often very difficult to change people's attitudes.
example_zh: 人們對事情的看法通常是很難改變的。

chinese_meaning: （尤因具有積極、值得讚賞的品質而）吸引;招引;引起
example_en: These flowers are brightly coloured in order to attract butterflies.
example_zh: 這些花朵都有著鮮艷的色彩以便能夠吸引蝴蝶。

chinese_meaning: 吸引（力）;有吸引力的事物
example_en: Life in Los Angeles has so many attractions - nightclubs, good restaurants, and so on.
example_zh: 洛杉磯的生活有很多誘人之處——夜總會、高級餐廳等等。

example_en: She lectures to audiences all over the world.
example_zh: 她向世界各地的聽眾發表演講。

example_en: He is the author of two books on French history.
example_zh: 他是兩部法國歷史著作的作者。

example_en: The average of the three numbers 7, 12, and 20 is 13, because the total of 7, 12, and 20 is 39, and 39 divided by 3 is 13.
example_zh: 7、12和20這三個數的平均數是13，因為7、12和20的和是39，而39除以3是13。

example_en: I try to avoid supermarkets on Saturdays - they're always so busy.
example_zh: 我儘量避開週六去超級市場——那時總是人特別多。

example_en: "Is Oliver awake yet?" "Yes, he's wide (= completely) awake and running around his bedroom."
example_zh: 「奧利弗醒了嗎？」「是的，他完全醒了，正在睡房裡亂跑呢。」

example_en: Am I included?
example_zh: 包括我嗎？

chinese_meaning: （尤指為個人私利而）濫用;妄用
example_en: She is continually abusing her position/authority by getting other people to do things for her.
example_zh: 她不斷濫用職權／權力，讓別人替她做事。

example_en: a military/police academy
example_zh: 軍事／員警學院

example_en: The idea rapidly gained acceptance (= became approved of) in political circles.
example_zh: 這個想法很快就得到了政界的認同。

chinese_meaning: 為…提供住宿;容納;為…提供空間
example_en: New students may be accommodated in halls of residence.
example_zh: 新生可以住在學校宿舍裡。

chinese_meaning: 熟練的；有造詣的；有才藝的
example_en: She's a very accomplished pianist/painter/horsewoman.
example_zh: 她是一位很有造詣的鋼琴家／很有才華的畫家／技藝高超的騎師。

example_en: When we receive your instructions we will act accordingly.
example_zh: 我們接到你的指示就會遵命行事。

example_en: I withdrew my money and asked the bank to close my account.
example_zh: 我拿了錢，並要求銀行關閉我的帳戶。

example_en: the ace of hearts/clubs/spades/diamonds
example_zh: 紅心／梅花／黑桃／方塊 A

example_en: The acquisition of huge amounts of data has helped our research enormously.
example_zh: 獲得的大量數據對我們的研究有莫大的幫助。

example_en: He wants to get into acting.
example_zh: 他想從事演藝工作。

example_en: He is 90 years old, but remains active in the local community.
example_zh: 他已經 90 歲了，但仍然活躍在當地社區。

chinese_meaning: 激進主義分子，行動主義分子;積極分子
example_en: He's been a trade union/party activist for many years.
example_zh: 多年來他一直是工會／黨的積極分子。

example_en: She's the highest-paid actress in Hollywood.
example_zh: 她是好萊塢片酬最高的女演員。

chinese_meaning: （尤指不情願的）承認;供認;招認
example_en: Her silence was taken as an admission of guilt.
example_zh: 她的沉默被視為認罪。

chinese_meaning: （使）前進；使進步，使進展；使發展；促進
example_en: The fire advanced steadily through the forest.
example_zh: 大火在森林中不斷蔓延。

example_en: She works for an investment advisory firm.
example_zh: 她在一家投資顧問公司工作。

example_en: The new building has little aesthetic value/appeal.
example_zh: 新樓幾乎沒有甚麼美學價值。

example_en: The world's supply of agricultural land is shrinking fast.
example_zh: 世界農業用地面積正在迅速減少。

chinese_meaning: 人工智慧（artificial intelligence的縮寫）;人工授精（artificial insemination的縮寫）

example_en: He gets about with the aid of a walking stick.
example_zh: 他拄著拐杖到處走動。

example_en: If there's any trouble, raise/sound the alarm by pulling the emergency cord.
example_zh: 如果出現任何問題，拉緊急警報索報警。

example_en: an alien spacecraft
example_zh: 外星人飛船

example_en: I fell over and twisted my ankle.
example_zh: 我摔倒了，扭傷了腳踝。

chinese_meaning: （用於疑問句和否定句中）有人，任何人;隨便哪個人

example_en: Call round to see me anytime.
example_zh: 甚麼時候有空就過來看看我。

example_en: You can run an app on your PC that will find the files and burn them to a CD.
example_zh: 你可以在電腦上啟動一個應用程式，找到文檔並拷貝成光碟。

example_en: This part of the law is only applicable to companies employing more than five people.
example_zh: 該法律這一部分條款僅適用於有五名以上僱員的公司。

chinese_meaning: （尤指透過書面或表格形式）申請，請求
example_en: We've applied for a grant to get funding for the project.
example_zh: 我們已經申請了贈款以獲得該項目的資金。

example_en: The ball rose in a high arc and fell behind the boundary line.
example_zh: 球在空中高高地劃了一條弧線落在邊線外。

example_en: Polar bears live in the Arctic.
example_zh: 北極熊生活在北極地區。

chinese_meaning: （體育比賽或表演用的）場地，競技場，劇場
example_en: an Olympic/a sports arena
example_zh: 奧運會／運動會比賽場地

example_en: They have been charged with supplying arms to the guerrillas.
example_zh: 他們被指控向遊擊隊提供軍火。

chinese_meaning: （尤指非常有吸引力、令人讚賞並常以特定的方式排列的）一系列，一批，大量，大群
example_en: There was a splendid array of food on the table.
example_zh: 滿桌子都是美味佳餚。

chinese_meaning: （尤指煙草、煤、木頭燃燒後的）灰，灰燼
example_en: cigarette ash
example_zh: 煙灰

example_en: an assured performance
example_zh: 自信的表演

chinese_meaning: （包圍地球的）大氣，大氣層，大氣圈
example_en: These factories are releasing toxic gases into the atmosphere.
example_zh: 這些工廠向大氣中排放有毒氣體。

example_en: The children are very attached to their grandparents.
example_zh: 孩子們非常依戀他們的祖父母。

example_en: A man is being questioned in relation to the attempted murder/robbery last night.
example_zh: 一名男子因涉嫌昨晚的謀殺／搶劫未遂案受到盤問。

chinese_meaning: 聲音的;錄音的;播音的;音頻的
example_en: an audiocassette
example_zh: 卡式錄音帶

example_en: The town is dominated by its large auto assembly plant.
example_zh: 該鎮以其大型汽車組裝廠而聞名。

chinese_meaning: 航空（學）；飛行（術）；航空工業
example_en: the British Civil Aviation Authority
example_zh: 英國民航局

example_en: The earth revolves around the axis that joins the North and South Poles.
example_zh: 地球圍繞貫穿南北兩極的地軸自轉。
